# Customitin

> Local-first React Native personalization SDK. Functional alpha; packages are not published. Prefer the CLI and durable overrides over hand-written registries.

## Additional references

- [Architecture and quick start](README.md)
- [Runtime extension contracts](docs/extensions.md)

- [Native testing](docs/native-testing.md)
- [Release gates](docs/release-checklist.md)

Use inspect to discover exact symbols. Use schema for the authoritative overrides format. Never infer completeness from an array/cache, run hooks outside React, or put model keys in the app. Generated files belong to the CLI; config.ts and overrides.json belong to the developer.
